notes.content:

notes.title: LudoNarraCon is LIVE -- join us and other amazing developers & games!
notes.content:
LudoNarraCon 2020 is officially a go, and we're honored to be a part of it! ːgorkydanceː 

Starting now until April 27th, you can enjoy narrative indie games to the fullest, with sales, demos, panels, and other livestreams. Of course, we wouldn't want to miss out, so here's what you can expect from us:

[list]
[*]A (whopping) 35% discount on Still There
[*]A pre-recorded partial playthrough where we talk about design decisions and drop other such nuggets of would-be wisdom
[*]For those unconvinced by ^ -- a playable demo of Still There!
[*]Our own [url=https://twitter.com/demigiant]Daniele Giardini (Demigiant) [/url]will be joining 3 other talented developers to talk on the [i]Emergent vs. Traditional Game Narratives[/i] panel on [u]April 25th, 18:00 CEST[/u], which will be streamed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33025617/sale/ludonarracon]here[/url].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/33df8b9611e2a9d56ba6fc49b2ddaf94150a9f50.jpg[/img]


[h3]The Demo[/h3]

Who doesn't like a proper demo? We do. That's why you can try before you buy. Get a little slice of Karl's life by peeping the demo on Steam.

[h3]The Panel[/h3]

As mentioned above, [url=https://twitter.com/demigiant]Daniele Giardini (Demigiant) [/url] will be joining the developers of [i]Star Dynasties[/i], [i]Football Drama[/i], and [i]In Other Waters[/i] on a panel discussing narrative in video games, more specifically the differences between traditional narrative and emergent narrative. Don't know what that means, exactly? Tune in and find out! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/33025617/sale/ludonarracon]April 25th, 18:00 CEST, right here.[/url] Hope to see you there ːgorkyxoxoː

Like the other lovely exhibitors at LudoNarraCon, you can grab Still There on sale! In fact, on its deepest sale yet, a jaw-dropping and show-stopping 35% off!

notes.title: Still There digitally attending LudoNarraCon 2020!
notes.content:
Do you like narrative driven indie games? Do you like gaming conventions minus all the cramming and sweat? 

If your answer to these two questions was [i]yes[/i], then we have some good news for you:

[b]
Still There and GhostShark Games will be attending LudoNarraCon as an exhibitor and panelist![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/e08192d2f0de3c96ab4cbc92cbf1c0d44ae415b5.jpg[/img]


[h2]What is LudoNarraCon?[/h2]

LudoNarraCon is a [b]digital convention[/b], hosted on Steam, set up by [url=https://twitter.com/FellowTravellr]Fellow Traveller[/url] -- oh, and it's [b]FREE[/b] to attend!

Here's what you can expect as an attendee:

[list]
[*]Thought-provoking panels and discussions arround narrative games
[*]Explore upcoming games with a strong focus on narrative through livestreams
[*]Sales on all exhibitors' games (hey, that includes us!)
[*]Demos of a bunch of different narrative games
[/list]

[h2]Sounds cool! what are you doing?[/h2]

We're going to be doing the following:

[list]
[*]Our very own [url=https://twitter.com/demigiant]Daniele Giardini (Demigiant)[/url] will be talking on the [i]Emergent Vs. Traditional Game Narratives[/i] panel.
[*]There will be a demo of Still There available for those of you who haven't gotten around to play it yet.
[*]We'll get a loop of cool footage going for you to watch on the Still There store page.
[*]Still There will be on sale.
[/list]

We're excited to attend this year's LudoNarraCon, and hope you'll join us -- we're gonna have a blast!

More info: https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/group/33025617/view/1827838782002270091

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Eliminate the competition
notes.content:
Oh, I see how it is. I see you, Walker. You’re just… you’re lucky you’re always wrong about everything, mate, or this would get messy very fast.

We like competition here in the Pleasuredome, although the thousands of games whose digital innards coat the walls might not. It is time, of course, for the last fight in the Unknown Pleasures schedule before the big one. The last chance for one of the countless little-known games on Steam to sneak in and seize a spot in the hallowed best of 2019 list. It’s already close, my friends. It is very close.

Automatically disagreeing with John on principle this week: electoral events, cowboy cutters, and robot roads.

notes.title: Still There is available now!
notes.content:
The stars have aligned and we are thrilled to announce that [b]Still There[/b] is available today on Steam! We are so happy and proud to share this experience with all of you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/0e611083f7424e0df24969736660131fa83b7050.jpg[/img]
https://youtu.be/_1WS85PqAOU
[b]Still There[/b] is more than a simple game to us – it has had a profound impact on our lives. It has been the fulfilment of a promise that was told to the child version of ourselves, and has been an important test of our own feelings.

It has required many compromises and struggles and has, without a doubt, left its mark on us. Parts of us will always be in the game, and players across the world will experience our most intimate selves while playing [b]Still There[/b].

[i]We hope it will leave an impact on you too.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35131894/decba077fb3aa296cc243e114d8e9df6edd11e2f.png[/img]
[b]Beware:[/b] you might laugh, cry, question the meaning of life and really, [i]really[/i] fancy some tasty Italian coffee... all at once!

[b]Still There[/b] combines technical puzzles and space-station management with themes of grief and guilt; sprinkled with some dark humour and a wacky AI. How much are you willing to sacrifice to rescue yourself and your loved ones, and how far is far enough?

notes.title: Still There Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:

notes.title: Still There will let you be sad but in space this autumn
notes.content:
Space lighthousekeeper sounds like a dream job, which is unfortunately usually a warning sign that it might be too good to be true. That certainly seems to be the case in Still There, in which protagonist Karl is alone out in the quiet vacuum of space, kept company only by an AI, a strange radio message, some puzzles, and his thoughts. Here s a trailer from the depths of the starry void.

notes.title: Psychological Adventure Game ‘Still There’ Announced
notes.content:
Hello to our cool community!

We are thrilled to announce that Iceberg Interactive will be collaborating with GhostShark Games on new sci-fi psychological adventure game [i][b]Still There[/b][/i]. The game is scheduled for release in Fall 2019 for PC (Windows) and Nintendo Switch™.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35131894/0e611083f7424e0df24969736660131fa83b7050.jpg[/img]

You can sample the game’s atmospheric look and feel in this brand new trailer: [url=https://youtu.be/733Fx_h8FIk]https://youtu.be/733Fx_h8FIk[/url]
Every day is the same on the faraway Bento space-lighthouse - until a mysterious radio message breaks through. Evade the past, welcome oblivion, make the perfect Italian coffee. [b][i]Still There[/i][/b] is a psychological adventure game about grief, technical puzzles, wacky AIs and dark humour. How far is far enough?

[h1][u][b]About Still There[/b][/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Maintain your space lighthouse by solving brain-bending puzzles and completing your daily tasks. Urine may be involved.
[*] Respond to emergency situations, take vital decisions while you unravel the emotional story of Karl’s past. 
[*] Engage in hilarious conversations with Gorky, the station’s AI. 
[*] Confront complex issues, such as depression and grief, in the deeply immersive narrative. 
[*] Soak up the nostalgia with stunning retro graphics and visuals.
[/list]

Get ready to help Karl on his space missions by [b]wishlisting the game today[/b].
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063490/Still_There/[/url]
